verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right. The headline is clearly dominant, and the subhead sits centred above it. Its flaws: the photo is a tiny thumbnail beside a dead empty left margin, and the decorative squares are scattered, with the bottom pair jammed right against the 'P' of PLAYFUL. B butts the photo against the left edge and crops it, and enlarges the squares into a heavy, meaningless blocky glyph. It also leaves a large dead gap in the middle and squeezes the two-line PLAYFUL/LEARNING headline against the right canvas edge with no margin, beside the subhead, which looks cramped and lopsided.
